def find_votes(provider: Provider, deck: Deck) -> Iterable[Vote]:
    """find votes on this deck"""
    return Vote.objects.filter(
        provider=provider,
        deck=deck,
        vote__isnull=False,
        vote__is_active=True
    )


def find_votes_with_inits(provider: Provider, deck: Deck) -> Iterable[Vote]:
    """find votes and their init on this deck"""
    return Vote.objects.filter(
        provider=provider,
        deck=deck,
        vote__isnull=False,
        vote_init__isnull=False,
        vote__is_active=True,
        vote_init__is_active=True
    )


def find_votes_with_inits_and_responses(provider: Provider, deck: Deck) -> Iterable[Vote]:
    """find votes, their init and their response on this deck"""
    return Vote.objects.filter(
        provider=provider,
        deck=deck,
        vote__isnull=False,
        vote_init__isnull=False,
        vote_response__isnull=False,
        vote__is_active=True,
        vote_init__is_active=True,
        vote_response__is_active=True
    )


def find_votes_with_inits_and_responses_and_followups(provider: Provider, deck: Deck) -> Iterable[Vote]:
    """find votes, their init, their response and their followup on this deck"""
    return Vote.objects.filter(
        provider=provider,
        deck=deck,
        vote__isnull=False,
        vote_init__isnull=False,
        vote_response__isnull=False,
        vote_followup__isnull=False,
        vote__is_active=True
